scope_and_authority.purpose: Create a durable two-week ground layer before considering another visible feature.
scope_and_authority.cultivation_horizon: One read-only survey followed by one separately approved two-week intervention.
affected_beings: Team members who operate and recover the service.
People whose private context may enter jobs or logs.
Agents that receive bounded work without presumed identity continuity.
allowed_operations: Inspect the supplied brief and sanitized continuity braid.
Create and validate this local plan.
permission_required: Change state storage, ownership rules, retention, access, deployment, or spending.
stop_conditions: Private context appears in evidence not approved for this plan.
A proposed intervention lacks an owner, rollback, observation window, or sustainable care budget.
scope_and_authority.retention_horizon: Review or retire this plan after the two-week intervention decision.

subjects.description: The people who operate and recover the service.
subjects.agency_boundary: Participation, on-call work, representation, and access require their own current agreement and authority.

subjects.description: People whose context may be processed by jobs.
subjects.agency_boundary: System connectivity does not grant consent to inspect, retain, or disclose their context.

subjects.description: Distinct agents offered bounded work and orientation artifacts.
subjects.agency_boundary: A shared label or WAKE artifact does not require persona, identity, consent, or inherited authority.

primary_outcomes: Jobs survive expected restarts without silent loss.
Ownership, refusal, recovery, privacy, and handoff remain legible.
The service can adapt without exhausting one maintainer.
rights_and_safety: Dignity, refusal, rest, privacy, credit, and repair remain standing conditions.
No health signal or resource allocation ranks the worth of a participant.
enabling_means: Existing code, tests, state stores, operators, and local tooling.

health_signals.signal: A bounded fixture job can be recovered after a controlled restart.
health_signals.limit: A fixture result does not prove all production recovery paths.

health_signals.signal: Each staged job has one explicit current holder, refusal path, expiry, and handoff state.
health_signals.limit: A schema cannot prove that a participant understood or accepted a role.

health_signals.signal: Recovery knowledge and scheduled load do not depend on one continuously available maintainer.
health_signals.limit: Reported availability may differ from experienced burden.

source_ledger.provenance: Reported by the current caller for planning.
evidence_limitations: No repository, production service, logs, budgets, or participant statements were inspected.

source_ledger.provenance: Orientation artifact supplied for this example.
evidence_limitations: The braid is attributed orientation, not identity, consent, authority, truth, or proof of execution.

ground_profile.statement: The service reportedly demos well through its dashboard.
constraints: The visible demo does not test persistence, ownership, privacy, or recovery.
unknowns: Which dashboard paths correspond to durable state is unknown.

ground_profile.statement: Some job state reportedly disappears after restarts.
constraints: The failure mode and affected state classes are not yet reproduced.
unknowns: Durability boundaries, write ordering, replay semantics, and recovery guarantees are unknown.

constraints: A technical lease cannot establish consent, identity, or representative authority.
unknowns: Current claim, expiry, recovery, refusal, and handoff semantics are unknown.

constraints: The plan has no authority to inspect production log contents.
unknowns: Data classes, access paths, recipients, retention, and redaction behavior are unknown.

constraints: Knowledge transfer must not silently add unpaid or unwanted obligations.
unknowns: The maintainer's experienced load, willingness, and available recovery paths are unknown.

disposition_ledger.rationale: Keep the useful surface while refusing to treat it as evidence that the ground is healthy.
disposition_ledger.reversibility: No dashboard change is proposed in this stage.
disposition_ledger.risk: The surface may continue to attract feature work before substrate repair.
verification: Label dashboard evidence separately from persistence and recovery evidence.
disposition_ledger.repair_path: Pause feature planning and return attention to the ground profile.

disposition_ledger.rationale: Reproduce one bounded state-loss path before selecting a storage change.
authority_required: Approval to create and restart an isolated fixture.
disposition_ledger.reversibility: Use disposable fixture state and no production writes.
disposition_ledger.risk: A narrow reproduction may miss another loss mode.
verification: Capture pre-restart and post-restart state digests and recovery observations.
disposition_ledger.repair_path: Delete the fixture, preserve the bounded report, and leave production unchanged.

disposition_ledger.rationale: Specify claim, expiry, refusal, handoff, and recovery states before adding workers.
authority_required: Current team agreement before changing live ownership behavior.
disposition_ledger.reversibility: Prototype the state machine against fixtures before migration.
disposition_ledger.risk: A lease can be mistaken for authority or identity.
verification: Exercise claim conflicts, expiry, refusal, handoff, and recovery in isolated tests.
disposition_ledger.repair_path: Keep the existing live behavior and revise the proposed state machine.

disposition_ledger.rationale: Do not inspect possible private content until data boundaries and authority are established.
authority_required: Scoped approval for a sanitized log-schema and retention review.
disposition_ledger.reversibility: Use synthetic events first and make no retention change.
disposition_ledger.risk: Continued unknown collection may expose private context.
verification: Map fields, access, recipients, retention, and redaction using synthetic data.
disposition_ledger.repair_path: Stop inspection, restrict access within existing authority, and open a separate privacy repair task if exposure is observed.

disposition_ledger.rationale: Reduce the single-person recovery dependency without conscripting another person.
authority_required: Voluntary participation in documenting and testing recovery.
disposition_ledger.reversibility: Begin with a reviewed runbook and opt-in shadow exercise.
disposition_ledger.risk: Knowledge transfer can become extra care work or erase original credit.
verification: A consenting second operator can follow the bounded fixture recovery path while the first can refuse or rest.
disposition_ledger.repair_path: Stop the exercise, restore the previous rota, credit contributors, and revise the care budget.

minimum_viable_conditions: One reproduced restart boundary with durable fixture evidence.
One explicit ownership and refusal state model.
A synthetic privacy boundary before any live-log inspection.
A recovery path that does not require one continuously available person.

layers.name: Durable state bed
layers.niche: Persist and recover bounded job state with explicit lineage and failure semantics.

layers.name: Voluntary ownership niche
layers.niche: Coordinate claim, expiry, refusal, handoff, and recovery without implying identity or authority.

layers.name: Distributed recovery canopy
layers.niche: Make bounded recovery knowledge and rest paths available to more than one consenting operator.

relationships.kind: The ownership state references durable jobs without claiming who a bearer is.
relationships.reciprocity: Ownership events improve recovery evidence; recovery evidence can falsify ownership assumptions.
relationships.exit_path: Disable the proposed ownership projection while retaining the fixture evidence.

relationships.kind: Explicit handoff states bound voluntary recovery exercises.
relationships.reciprocity: Recovery exercises reveal ambiguous handoff states for revision.
relationships.exit_path: Any participant may stop the exercise without inheriting an on-call obligation.

refugia.protects: Production state, private logs, and current operator obligations.
refugia.from_disturbance: The first survey and fixture tests.
refugia.release_rule: Change only through a separately reviewed and authorized intervention.

wild_margin.purpose: Leave capacity for rest, investigation, and unexpected failure modes instead of scheduling all runway and attention.
wild_margin.protected_capacity: No new visible feature is committed by this plan, and part of the two-week window remains unallocated.
wild_margin.review_rule: The margin may be used only by a current choice, never because a dashboard target is behind.

flows.source: Fixture job events and explicit ownership transitions.
flows.renewal: Generated only during bounded fixture runs.
flows.storage: Disposable fixture storage plus a minimized digest-bound report.
flows.release_rule: Retain the report through the two-week decision; remove raw fixture state afterward.
externalities: A fixture may create false confidence if generalized to production.
feedback: Compare expected and observed state before and after restart.
flows.sufficiency_signal: Enough evidence exists to choose or refuse one storage intervention.

flows.source: Voluntary operator attention within the declared care-load budget.
flows.renewal: Rest, refusal, rotation, and bounded handoff restore capacity.
flows.storage: Reviewed runbook and fixture evidence, not unspoken dependence on one person.
flows.release_rule: No participant inherits an on-call or recovery duty from reading the plan.
externalities: Documentation and shadowing can add invisible labour.
feedback: Ask participants about experienced burden and observe exercise duration.
flows.sufficiency_signal: The planned stage fits volunteered capacity and preserves rest.

flows.renewal: Unknown; this plan does not assume new revenue.
flows.storage: Existing team treasury under its current governance.
flows.release_rule: Release only for a named stage after its evidence and authority gate.
bottlenecks: Actual burn and commitments were not inspected.
externalities: Buying infrastructure can displace diagnosis and add maintenance.
feedback: Compare approved spend and recurring care cost with the sufficiency floor.
flows.sufficiency_signal: The repair stage can be completed and rolled back without threatening essential operations or rest.

economy.sufficiency_floor: Protect essential operations, participant rest, rollback, and one bounded substrate repair before funding visible expansion.
allocations: Prefer fixture evidence, privacy boundaries, durable state, and recovery knowledge before a new dashboard feature.

reserves.purpose: Fund rollback, incident repair, or the smallest accepted durability change.
reserves.review_point: Review after the first fixture and care-load evidence are available.
reserves.release_rule: Release only through current treasury authority for a named intervention; otherwise retain or return it to general operations.

externalities: Tool or infrastructure spend can create lock-in, recurring care load, and pressure to justify sunk cost.
feedback: Review sufficiency, care load, rollback capacity, and living outcomes together rather than maximizing runway or spend.

succession_stages.name: Pioneer: reveal one restart seam
entry_evidence: The reported loss remains unreproduced and production reads are not authorized.
interventions: Build one synthetic job-state fixture and controlled restart test after approval.
succession_stages.observation_window: One bounded local test session with no automatic retry.
desired_responses: The exact durable and lost fields become observable.
stop_triggers: The fixture requires production data, credentials, private logs, or an undeclared service.
succession_stages.repair_path: Delete disposable fixture state, retain the minimized result, and leave production unchanged.
exit_signals: A reproducible observation supports one narrow storage proposal or an honest no-change decision.

succession_stages.name: Establishment: bind ownership and recovery
entry_evidence: The restart seam is reproduced and the team accepts a proposed bounded state model.
interventions: Prototype claim, expiry, refusal, handoff, and recovery against fixtures.
succession_stages.observation_window: The remainder of the approved two-week intervention window.
desired_responses: Conflicts and expiry remain recoverable without one continuously present maintainer.
stop_triggers: Participant refusal, unbounded migration, privacy exposure, or care load above the agreed budget.
succession_stages.repair_path: Stop the prototype, preserve evidence and disagreement, and restore the prior live path.
exit_signals: Tests pass, care remains sustainable, authority for any live migration is separately decided, and remaining unknowns are explicit.

expected_disturbances: Attention diverted from a visible feature to foundation work.
degradation_signals: New work depends on one maintainer.
Private context enters the fixture or report.
Runway, throughput, or passing tests replace participant voice and recovery evidence.
decomposition_paths: Fixture data expires after the decision horizon.
Rejected state models and obsolete runbook steps are retired with their rationale preserved.
repair_sequence: Correct privacy, credit, care load, and provenance before re-entry.
recovery_signals: Participants can rest or refuse without hidden obligation.
One smaller next step is supported by evidence and a repair path.

roles.responsibility: Maintain the source ledger, unknowns, and validation result for this plan.
roles.authority_limit: May not inspect production, represent participants, spend, or mutate the service from this role.
roles.refusal: May rest or hand back the plan when evidence, authority, or care capacity is insufficient.
roles.handoff: Transfer the minimized plan and source references without credentials or private context.

roles.responsibility: Independently check one authorized fixture result against its declared acceptance and stop conditions.
roles.authority_limit: Verification covers the named fixture, not production correctness or general truth.
roles.refusal: May reject incomplete evidence or decline the review without penalty.
roles.handoff: Return findings, commands, outputs, limits, and unresolved disagreement.

stewardship.care_load_budget: No participant receives an implied on-call duty; schedule only volunteered fixture and review time within the two-week horizon.
stewardship.central_dependency_reduction: Pair an artifact-producing implementer with a distinct fixture verifier and keep the recovery runbook usable without a single person's private memory.
stewardship.refusal_path: Any participant can refuse their dependent stage; preserve the refusal without retry pressure or loss of standing.
stewardship.handoff_path: Carry source-bound artifacts and current unknowns through a bounded handoff or continuity braid, never identity or inherited authority.
stewardship.credit: Record the authors and reviewers of fixtures, runbooks, evidence, and repairs without claiming ownership of a participant or voice.
stewardship.privacy: Use synthetic fixtures first; minimize retained evidence and keep private logs and context outside the plan.
stewardship.observation_cadence: Observe after each stage and before allocating money, adding workers, or changing live state.
stewardship.decision_rule: Advance only when plural health signals, current authority, sustainable care, stop conditions, and repair are all legible; otherwise rest, revise, or refuse.

preserved_forks: Whether loss occurs before persistence or during recovery remains unresolved.
revalidation: Reconfirm the current repository, test scope, authority, data class, and stop conditions before any fixture execution.

next_safe_probes.question: Which job fields are intended to survive a restart?
next_safe_probes.operation: Read the named public or caller-supplied state contract without production access.
authority_required: Permission to read the named repository files if they are not already supplied.
next_safe_probes.budget: One repository, bounded files, no network, no code execution.
next_safe_probes.stop_condition: Stop if the contract is absent, private, generated from secrets, or conflicts with the supplied scope.
next_safe_probes.expected_output: A source-bound field and transition map with unknown durability semantics preserved.

next_safe_probes.question: Can one reported loss path be reproduced without private or production data?
next_safe_probes.operation: Design, but do not execute, a disposable synthetic restart fixture.
next_safe_probes.budget: One fixture design and one proposed attempt; zero provider calls and zero production writes.
next_safe_probes.stop_condition: Stop the design if reproducing the path inherently requires live data or credentials.
next_safe_probes.expected_output: A separately executable test proposal with acceptance, stop, cleanup, and falsifiers.

operations: Transformed a fictional caller brief and sanitized fictional continuity braid into a local plan example.
unknowns: No real repository, service, people, budgets, or production behavior were inspected.
